⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Dafay fomp Play Store + Google Play sarwis yi + Done yi ci kaadar sarwis yi. laalul.
• Aprey bi dafay tàmbaliwaat ci saa si ginaaw.

Yaakaar nga?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: dafay xool butoŋu butoŋu bi fi nekk ak limu Google biy dindi (CRL) ba noppi jéem ay balluwaay yu bari ba keroog mu gis butoŋu butoŋu bu baax, ak ab saaga bu otomatik ak tàmbaliwaat Google sarwis yi. Dafay daw ci robinet bu nekk te soxla internet (1-3 simili).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ci reso bi: dafay yebbi benn keybox ci dencukaay ofisel bi (GitHub) ba noppi denc ko ci /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Dafa soxla internet te jël na 1-3 simili. Dañu koy jëfandikoo sudee smart fetch bi deful wala sudee dañu soppi keybox bi ak loxo.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP saytu: xool module yi jàppandi ci joxe caabi yu sori, xool TEE xeetu sertifikaawu seede, ba noppi wane tolluwaayu jumtukaayu KmInstallKeybox. Soppiwul dara — ab xoolum tolluwaayu aparey bu leer.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine xool (liir kese): dafay wane Widevine màndarga niveau (L1/L3) yu bawoo ci dumpsys, nekkinu fichier-caabi DRM (IDM), ak màndarga sistem yi ci laale. Du soppali dara.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Defar RKP manuel: def sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manuel. Dafay saafara jafe-jafe yi ci seede sudee pass automatik bi jàllul. Bépp daw dafay imprime liiñ bu leer ci ndam/njàqare.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Fix RKP bu mat: def sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh bu mat. Dafay liggéey ci dosiye yu jafe yi te dina gëna yàgg. Resultat bu leer dina feeñ ci njeexte li.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: dafay fomp Play Store ak Google done yi (GMS+GSF) ba noppi tàmbaliwaat aparey bi ci saasi. Ngir seede bu dëgër bopp kese - du musa laal say nataal wala say fichier.
strings.mdCertify: • Sàrtifikaasioŋ Play: xool tolluwaayu seede sertifikaa RKP ci aparey bi ba noppi reset màndarga seede su ko jaree. Du laal done jëfandikukat bi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER defar: defar Google kaadar sarwis (SOTER) jafe-jafe yi jëm ci seede aparey. Dañu koy jëfandikoo ci yenn aparey yu wéeru ci SOTER ci barabu Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Jëfandikool PIF: def doole /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Jëfandikool emprent baraam biñ tànn (bërëb bi/avancé) ba noppi yeesal fichier pif.prop/pif.json yi. Resultaa bu leer dina feeñ ci log bi.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF saytu: dafay wane tolluwaayu motër biñ samp, fichier emprent baraam yi (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ak log yi. Saytu rek — du soppi dara.
strings.mdCanary: • Yeesal Canary: def sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Dafay jël Canary Engine bi mujjee génn ngir mëna ànd ak sertifikaa RKP yiñ wara am (fewriye 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Diagnostic moteur: xool tolluwaayu TrickyStoreOSS (pid, journal), fichier keybox (aktiif vs jëfandikukat), emprent barabu aparey dëgg vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP butoŋu. Affichage diagnostic kese.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module bi dafay yor ñaari barabu tombu: bu njëkk bi (sacré, musul efaase) ak bu ñaareel bi (backup). Onglet bii dafay wane ban slot mooy doxal, soppi tànneef, wala gëna xëcc ñaareel bi ci njëkk ci laaj bu leer - ak backups ak log bu mat.
strings.btnIntegrityFix: 🔧 Delloosi ko ci anam wu wóor
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Diagnostic njub: xool importation bu TEE, injection bibliothèque bi ci biir keystore2, tolluwaayu dindi (CRL), limu aar-coverage ak tolluwaayu RKP. Lire-only — du soppi dara.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Limu aar bi dafay tabaxaat ci bépp aplikaasioŋ buñ samp.
• Layer biy méngoo ak ROM biñ jagleel dafay jëfandikoowaat. tàmbaliwaat.

Dara duñu efaase te duñu musa laal boyet bu njëkk bi.

Wéyal?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: dafay wane tolluwaayu slot bu njëkk bi ak bu ñaareel bi, ba noppi weccoo tànneef ci seen biir. Primaire bi (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) dañu koy aar saa yu nekk te duñu ko musa fomp. Yokkateg ñaareel bi ci primaire dafay laaj firnde bu leer.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Yokkatal ñaareelu xar-xar bi ci njëkk:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml nekk ëmbiitu xar-xar bu njëkk bi.
• Njàngat bi fi nekk dañu koy denc ni backup balaa ñu koy wecci.
• Dara duñu efaase — liggéey bi mën nañu ko delloo.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Futti ñaareelu xarxar bi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml dinañu ko dindi.
• xarxar bu njëkk bi laalul.

Wéyal?

Smart keybox fetch (bu bees ci v3.17):

• Saytu butoŋu butoŋu bi fi nekk ak Google limu dindi yi (CRL). Dafa soxla internet (1 ba 3 simili). Wëy?

• Defarwaat RKP + tàmbaliwaat Google sarwis yi.

Wéyal?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Tambaliwaat Google sarwis yi:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — tàmbaliwaat kese.

strings.confirmRkpForce:
Forse joxewaat (Red Magic):

• Ngir aparey yi baña bàyyi xel ci boîte bu tombu yi.
• Dafay dox doonte butoŋu yi dañu wér.
• Amul benn done buñu efaase.

Wéyal?
strings.confirmCertify:
Forse Play Store sertifikaasioŋ:

• Dafay fomp cache Màngasin bi kese — sa kontu laalul.
• Tàmbaliwaat, ba noppi ubbi Màngasin bi.

Wéyal?
strings.confirmSoter:

• Dafay tàmbaliwaat vendor.soter serwiis bi.
• Dafay fomp SOTER done serwër bi kese.

Wéyal?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Defal emprent baraam (PIF):

• Soppi custom.pif.prop ba noppi samp ko ci yoonu motër bi.
• Dafay laaj nga tàmbaliwaat ci ganaw.

Wéyal?
strings.confirmCanary:
Yeesal emprent Canary:

• Dafay yebbi emprent Canary bi mujjee am ci Google.
• Dafay boole patch kaaraange bi + tàmbaliwaat sarwis yi Google (amul efaase). Wëy?
